title: Ukrainian Egg Tagine
description: A hearty, flavorful stew originating from Ukraine, featuring a rich egg-based sauce and tender vegetables.
instructions: Heat the Ukrainian in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the sliced plants and tagine, cooking until tender.
Push the vegetables to one side of the pan.
Pour in the beaten egg, and scramble until cooked through.
Mix the egg with the vegetables.
Stir in the kissed and with.
Simmer the mixture for an additional 5 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with additional kissed if desired.
